messages.subject: DT - stuck Processing...
parts:
Has anyone else had their DT::renderDataTable() stuck at "Processing..."

I have not been able to isolate the possible cause, because it works on a simple app, but not my big app.  

The javascript console shows:
Uncaught TypeError: table.rows(...).every is not a function

corresponding to these lines:
    if (server) table.on('draw.dt', function() {
      table.rows({page: 'current'}).every(function() {
        if (inArray(this.data()[0], selected)) {
          $(this.node()).addClass(selClass);
        }
      });
    });

messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: Re: DT - stuck Processing...
parts: I figured it out.  In case someone has this same issue -- make sure you don't have a mix of shiny::renderDataTable() and DT::renderDataTable().  That appears to have been the problem in my app.
